'''Kombat DMM4''' is a ONE-DAY 1on1 DMM4 tournament and taking place on '''Saturday, September 21 - 21:00 CEST'''. There will be no split divisions, everyone will be mixed into same single elimination bracket. It will be played on DMM4 MODE with both classical maps as well as new ones.

== Format ==
* '''Saturday, September 21'''
** 21:00 CEST
* Single elimination bracket
* All matches are {{Abbr|BO5|Best of 5}}
** First map is always '''END2'''
* Match settings: DMM4, 3 minute matches

== Rules ==
* Map order: All games are BO5, first map is always END2, then loser (P2) pick next, P1 pick, P2 pick, remaning as decider.
* Same map cannot be picked twice.
* Ping rules: Find a server that keeps both players around the same ping +/- 13ms, if there's a dispute in what server should be used, contact admin. This is a global tournament so try at best ability to find a fair server to keep ping relatively even.
* Client: ezQuake 3.6.x. For your own sake, update your client!
** Remember to check with f_version
* Ruleset: smackdown/qcon
** Remember to check with f_ruleset
* Walkovers will be given by admin after 20 minutes.
* Reporting: send screenshots in [http://discord.quake.world/ discord] channel: <mark>#kombat</mark>.
